**Topic 2**

The people of your community lack basic infrastructure and facilities. Write a letter of complaint to the Senior Divisional Officer of your community. Mention what is lacking in your community; Highlight the consequences of the lack of this infrastructure or basic facility, then state the importance of this infrastructure or facility to your community. Your name is Lynn Kingue. Your address is Post Office Box 2013 Mondoni.

questions.enonce_markdown: **Topic 2.** Write a formal letter of complaint to the Senior Divisional Officer about the lack of basic infrastructure in your community. Mention what is lacking, its consequences, and the importance of this infrastructure to the community. Your name is Lynn Kingue, address: Post Office Box 2013 Mondoni. *(200 to 250 words)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Une lettre formelle de plainte (*formal letter of complaint*) respecte une disposition imposée : adresse de l'expéditeur en haut, date, adresse ou titre du destinataire, formule d'appel formelle (*Dear Sir*), objet, corps structuré en paragraphes, formule de politesse finale (*Yours faithfully*) suivie de la signature. Le registre reste soutenu du début à la fin, sans expression familière ni contraction (*don't*, *can't*).

Le sujet impose trois contenus obligatoires : identifier précisément l'infrastructure manquante, en exposer les conséquences concrètes sur la population, puis justifier son importance pour la communauté. Ces trois points structurent naturellement les trois paragraphes du corps de la lettre.

### Corrigé détaillé - lettre modèle
Lynn Kingue

Post Office Box 2013

Mondoni

[Date]

The Senior Divisional Officer

Mondoni Division

**Dear Sir,**

**Subject: Complaint about the lack of a good road network in Mondoni**

I am writing on behalf of the population of Mondoni to bring to your attention a problem that has troubled our community for many years: the absence of a tarred road linking our village to the main town.

During the rainy season, the untarred road becomes almost impassable. Vehicles get stuck in the mud for hours, sick people struggle to reach the hospital in time, and farmers cannot transport their produce to the market before it spoils. Children also arrive late at school because of the long, difficult walk on a road full of potholes.

A good road would greatly improve the daily life of our community. It would allow farmers to sell their goods more easily, give patients quick access to medical care in emergencies, and encourage traders and investors to settle in our area, thereby creating more jobs for the youth.

I therefore humbly request that you consider our situation and take the necessary steps to have this road tarred as soon as possible. The whole community would be immensely grateful for your intervention.

Thanking you in advance for your kind attention.

**Yours faithfully,**

**Lynn Kingue**

### Piège à éviter
Ne mélange jamais le registre formel de la lettre avec des tournures familières : « I want to complain because the road is really bad » n'a pas sa place dans une lettre adressée à une autorité administrative, contrairement à une formulation soutenue comme « I am writing to bring to your attention... ».

### Conseil
Mémorise la formule d'appel et la formule de politesse comme un couple fixe : *Dear Sir* s'accorde avec *Yours faithfully* (destinataire non nommé personnellement), tandis que *Dear Mr/Mrs [Nom]* s'accorderait avec *Yours sincerely*. Ne jamais les mélanger.
